lines.text: Leaving the temple, Jesus tells a disciple that not one of the great buildings' stones will be left on another.
On the Mount of Sinai opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew privately ask Jesus when these things will happen.
The disciples will be beaten in synagogues and stand before governors and kings, and the Holy Spirit will speak through them.
When they see the abomination of desolation, those in Judea must flee to the valleys, and pray it is not in winter.
For the sake of the elect, the Lord has cut those days short, and Jesus has told them everything in advance.
